snippet.title: Crankstone Playdate Trailer
snippet.description:
Crankstone is a gallery shooter for the Playdate set in the Wild West where you shoot at outlaws during the day and play mini games at the saloon during the night.

Platform: Playdate
Genre: Shooting Gallery spiced up with mini games à la Wario Ware
Release date: 19/08/2025

Links:
- Buy on Catalog : https://play.date/games/crankstone
- Buy on my shop : https://shop.lugludum.com/collections/crankstone
- Newsletter to be informed on next games : https://www.lugludum.com/newsletter/ 
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/loudo.lugludum.com
- X: https://x.com/loudoweb

Credits:
- cinematic trailer made by MotionAlien
- music trailer by serjilio
- thx to Tyron and solodevs from Lyon for their help on energizing the cut
- a game by Lugludum
